niche.diet: Filter-feeder plankton, crustacean analogs, small fish analogs
niche.active: Dusk to dawn; hides in sediment during daylight flares

body: Flattened, eel-like torso with parallel dermal electrocyte folds; copper-chelating hepatopancreas; iron-sulfide marginal plates; lateral orange-eyed orbs

links: Brackish water conducts well but shorts in full brine
World salinity gradients and conductivity limits

skill.effect: Releases 15m radius pulse, stuns targets for 2s

chains.weakness: Voltage collapses in open brine pools (>3 S/m)
observe: Dermal folds ripple in rhythmic waves before strike
Prey freezes mid-swim, gills clamped shut

journal.en: It doesn't chase. It simply decides the water belongs to it.

analogues.mechanism: see the cited works; chain wording is the council's own

links: Sulfide weathering releases dissolved metals into lagoons
High environmental metal load and toxicity threshold

skill.effect: Absorbs 10% chemical damage, converts to 5 HP regen

chains.weakness: Cannot molt quickly if chelation load exceeds 3 charges
observe: Gills filter metallic glints from passing water
Liver tissue glows faint green under vent light
Molting crust falls to silt in layered sheets

journal.en: It drinks poison and wears it as armor.

links: Blue light scattered by suspended iron-oxide dust
K-star spectrum filtered by atmospheric aerosols
chains.weakness: Blinded by sudden flare brightening or lightning strikes
observe: Eyes reflect dull orange instead of silver
Pupils narrow sharply in open water
Tracks prey through thick dust clouds effortlessly

journal.en: The world is orange, but it sees the dark.

links: Extracts dissolved Fe2+/Fe3+ from prey tissue
Metabolism relies on iron-redox cycling for energy
Oxidative stress in metal-rich water demands rapid uptake

skill.effect: Heals 5 HP/sec while feeding on dead prey

chains.weakness: Immobile and vulnerable during the 4s feeding window
observe: Mouth flares like a bellows over the carcass
Water bubbles and acid-fog forms near the wound
Gills pulse rhythmically as ions flow inward

journal.en: It doesn't just eat flesh. It eats the rust inside it.

relations.note: (council kind 'commensal') Ferroluz clears vent-predators that would otherwise crush Cobrehorno's sinter terraces; Cobrehorno's metal caches fuel Ferroluz's molt cycles.

(council kind 'commensal') Cobrehorno concentrates metal sulfides that Ferroluz harvests for molt cycles; Ferroluz patrols the perimeter, deterring burrowing predators that would fracture Cobrehorno's sinter terraces.

temperament: Patient, explosive, territorial, avoids direct combat
secrets: Can sense prey by their weak bioelectric fields before they move.
Molting cycle coincides with lunar high tides and vent surges.
Avoids direct contact with oxidized crust; treats it as toxic.
moments: Watching it coil in the silt, then flash a blue-white arc that freezes a grazing crustacean mid-bite.

journal.en: It doesn't bite. It simply decides you are dead, and the water obeys.
The lagoons taste of copper and old lightning.
